---
title: "kdident"
---

## Description

Beautifully split character variables for output in table/listing.

## Parameters

**`invar`**

: Name of the input variable

  *Required:* Yes

**`maxln`**

: Maximum number of characters allowed per line

  *Required:* Yes

**`outvar`**

: Name of the output variable

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `&invar._new`

**`tabchar`**

: Tabulation characters, used to pad newlines

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `str($ $ $`

**`newlchar`**

: Newline character

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `str($n`

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary variables or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%kdident(aebodsys,17);
%kdident(lbcomm1,32,outvar=col10,tabchar=%str());
```
